text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Durandal and the 
others. If I recall correctly, the armor 
that was scheduled to be exhibited went 
"missing", and they were searching for it—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
According to what I heard... The armor 
disappeared from its original owner's 
mansion just before being transported to 
the art space.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If it is wandering around, it might still 
be somewhere in the vicinity...!

Armor moving on its own... Could such a 
thing really be possible? Yet, drawn in by 
their earnest dedication—
choice_data_list: ...Mind if I come along with you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Really?! That would be most 
appreciated...! The more hands we have, 
the better.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Then let us make haste! Even if our clues 
are sparse, we will search thoroughly...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
We received permission to search the 
grounds, but... To think there would be 
such an... a-atmospheric warehouse here—
(*Whooooosh...*)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...I-It is not guaranteed that there are 
no clues, after all...!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Um, shall I go take a look? You know, 
we could split up to search different 
places—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
N-No...! I shall go as well. After all, I 
was the one who proposed it...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Everywhere is completely silent, huh... 
Well, no one's around, so I guess that 
makes sense...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! No matter what springs 
forth, I swear upon my knight's honor that 
I will protect you...!
(CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Gh!? Fall back! Fall baaaack!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! That startled me...! Sorry 
for running away first...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all... It is fine as long as we 
are unharmed, yes? Fufu, fufufu... Come, 
let us advance...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It seems it was not in the storeroom, was 
it... Alright, next... let us go...!
choice_data_list:
Um, are you okay? Aren't you pushing 
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, something of this degree is not 
even... ...worth mentioning... at all...!

However, even after that. As we searched 
out-of-the-way places for the armor, the 
eerie atmosphere persisted—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Phew... phew...!
(FLAP FLAP!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Gh!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Guh... How pathetic...! Reduced to this 
state by a mere flap of a bird's wings...!
choice_data_list: Your guard is on maximum alert...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-It can't be helped... We've been getting 
startled non-stop...!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Your face is completely pale. Searching 
is important, but... I think I'd rather 
you took a rest?
choice_data_list: We could also turn back once and regroup.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, I wish to press forward. No, I 
must press forward...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...If it truly is wandering in search of 
its master... it is far too heartbreaking.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...I am merely paying homage to eternal 
loyalty.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...For we both walk the very same path of 
chivalry.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, sorry to interrupt your talk, but I 
think something glinted over there for a 
second...

Looking in the direction she pointed... 
indeed, something catches the faint 
sunlight and shines.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...! This is part of the ornamentation 
from plate armor!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Beside it, though faint, are 
footprints. They're about the size... of 
an adult man's, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A piece of armor... footprints... This is 
indisputably—!
choice_data_list:
Wait, does that mean the armor was 
here...!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Eh, eh, really? Durandal-chan, did you 
just make an incredible discovery...!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, might we not hold conviction with 
absolute certainty now...?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That the armor of loyalty still wanders 
even now, in search of its master—!
choice_data_list: Splendid display of a knight's pride!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ufufu... *cough*. No, not yet.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
We shall find the armor, inquire about its 
master— and without fail, avenge that 
knight's regrets!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Once we find the armor, I shall ask in 
detail about its lord's traits. ...Even if 
they are no longer in this world, as long 
as it seeks its master, I shall lend my 
aid.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If it is a lord it revered from the bottom 
of its heart, it must wish to meet them as 
soon as possible. We must make haste...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...! To rejoice to such an 
extent when the incident is not yet 
resolved...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Please save that celebration for later. 
I shall surely guide this to a grand 
finale...!
